messages:
Morgan: quick heads-up — onboarding guide (handbook/onboarding/runtime.md) shows a broken embedded GDoc in the 'example prompts' section, and there's no CODEOWNER listed. who can pick this up?
Arya: I can take a look this afternoon. can you paste the embed id or a screenshot?
Morgan: thanks @Arya. the page shows an empty iframe with a 403 in console. here's the iframe HTML we render: `<iframe src=\"https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdEfGh/view\"></iframe>`
Jamal: fwiw our CDN audit flagged that same URL as an external embed that failed auth for some viewers, so it might need to be rehosted or swapped to a static snapshot. docs-bot flagged it as embed-orphan id: 7321.
docs-bot: automated-scan: embed-orphan detected in handbook/onboarding/runtime.md (id=7321) — recommended action: rehost to KB or replace with code snippet.
Sam: if we rehost, prefer adding it under /assets/onboarding/ as a markdown snapshot and reference it with our standard embed component. quick sed to add frontmatter owner could be: ```bash
sed -i '1s/^/owner: @Arya\\n/' handbook/onboarding/runtime.md
```
Arya: sounds good. I'll: 1) snapshot the GDoc to markdown, 2) add owner frontmatter, 3) open a tiny PR with rehosted file + replace iframe with our embed component. aiming for a single commit.
Morgan: awesome — can you add a short changelog note so product knows the onboarding guide was updated? also cc @Sam for a quick CR.
Sam: +1, happy to review. @Arya ping me when the PR is up and I'll do a fast pass (esp. verify internal links).
Arya: thanks — PR will be up within a few hours. leaving a reminder: if anyone else hits broken embeds while sprinting, please drop them here and include the page path + console snippet.
Jamal: tiny note on the snapshot: preserve the prompt examples as fenced code blocks, we can compress images if needed. also add a short eval anchor so our runtime examples tests can reference the new snapshot.
Morgan: perfect. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
Arya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — title: "rehost onboarding runtime GDoc -> md, add owner" — @Sam can you please review?
Sam: LGTM overall, left 2 tiny nits re internal link targets. requesting a small follow-up commit.
Arya: done, pushed fix. merge on green.
Morgan: merged — thanks @Arya @Sam. leaving a short note in the release channel about the onboarding update.
docs-bot: changelog: handbook/onboarding/runtime.md updated (owner=@Arya) — embed-orphan 7321 resolved.
